title: inspectframe
summary: MSUI now implements the missing/reproduced Inspect details while retaining its working architecture. The production path carries target/party origin, repeats the full transition, follows both registered events, keeps the global-target close rule, contains the portrait, disables the selected tab, honors both rotation edges, exposes only public entries/enchants, and emits a complete observational draw/input/state census. Connected foreign-player and screenshot proof remains outstanding.
